callouts.html: Billing through 2026-06-30. Calendar H1 is €955k vs €815k (+17.3%). Commercial in that window is +20.5%. Credit notes are not sales.
Warranty is 22.4% of calendar 2025 billed euro — not the majority of the book. Commercial 2023→2025 is +13.3% (€1.17m → €1.24m → €1.33m).
July this year is not in the billing file yet, so July cannot be split. Do not read an official July miss from this pack.

aim.note: Catalogue family is PR00 group on the parts catalogue. 99.9% of Calendar 2025 commercial euros have a family name. The clustered bars name families from the selected window (at least €4,000 in either year, or 3% of the window). Other is unclassified plus families below that cut — not every classified euro. No Shell lubricant lines in this book, so Shell is not on the chart. On Calendar 2025 with warranty hidden, Other is 5,997 € (0%): Consumables €2,803, Belts €2,057, Unclassified €1,137.
